power_domains_summary.form_factor_supplies: Determined by form factor — M.2 (3.3 V), U.2 (3.3 V + 12 V + optional 12 V Aux), EDSFF E1.S / E3.S (12 V), AIC (3.3 V + 12 V + 3.3 Vaux).
power_domains_summary.internal_domains: Vendor-specific: PCIe PHY analog (vccaux ~ 0.85 / 1.0 V), digital core (~ 0.7-0.9 V), NAND VCC (~ 3.3 V) + Vread/Vpgm/Verase generated by on-die charge pumps.
power_domains_summary.power_loss_protection: Enterprise SSDs include capacitor-based Power-Loss Protection (PLP); host-driven Abrupt Shutdown Notification (CC.SHN=10b) signals controller to commit pending writes using PLP energy.

power_states_psd_array.source: Identify Controller PSD (Power State Descriptor) array — NPSS+1 entries (NPSS in Identify Controller byte 263).
power_states_psd_array.selection: Set Features FID=02h Power Management; CDW11.PS = desired state index.

autonomous_power_state_transition_apst.source: Set Features FID=0Ch (Autonomous Power State Transition).
autonomous_power_state_transition_apst.purpose: Controller autonomously transitions to lower power state after idle window; transition tables encoded in 256-byte APST structure in PRP buffer.
autonomous_power_state_transition_apst.constraint: Only Power States with NOPS=0 (Operational) participate in APST; Non-Operational states require host re-engagement.

power_up_sequence: 1. Form-factor power supplies (+3.3 V and/or +12 V) ramp.
2. PERST# remains asserted during VDD ramp + at least 100 ms after stable.
5. Within 100 ms after PERST# deassert, controller is ready for PCIe Configuration access (Conventional Reset spec).
6. Host BIOS/OS enumerates the PCI Function.
7. Host runs NVMe controller initialization sequence (CAP read, AQA/ASQ/ACQ write, CC.EN=1, etc.).

low_power_modes_summary.D3hot: PCI Express low-power; configuration space accessible; main power retained; host wakes via PCIe PME.
low_power_modes_summary.D3cold: Power removed; PCI Configuration Space lost; PME via auxiliary wakeup if supported.
low_power_modes_summary.NVMe_PS_Operational: Active power states selectable per Identify Controller PSD; controller services commands.
low_power_modes_summary.NVMe_PS_NonOperational: Non-operational power states; controller doesn't service commands; transition takes ENLAT/EXLAT µs.
low_power_modes_summary.APST: Autonomous Power State Transition; controller drops to lower state after idle window.

shutdown_notification.normal_shutdown_cc_shn_01b: Host directs controller to drain + flush + commit + set CSTS.SHST=10b; safe power removal afterward.
shutdown_notification.abrupt_shutdown_cc_shn_10b: Controller may use PLP capacitors to commit pending writes; CSTS.SHST=10b set without drain guarantee.
shutdown_notification.purpose: Avoid silent data loss on power down.

host_memory_buffer_power_interaction.lifetime: Buffer is allocated by host and given to controller; controller may use as cache; buffer is unreliable across D3cold; host should disable HMB before D3cold.

fields.notes: Power management spans three layers in NVMe: (1) PCIe D-states managed via PCI Power Management Capability; (2) NVMe Power States managed via Set Features FID 02h and APST; (3) form-factor-specific power-rail control + PLP. Section 8.4 of the spec is normative for NVMe-layer power management.
